facts.fact: 训练闪回：Waren 兄弟对练——换武器失手被斥「You cannot let yourself get distracted...It will more likely than not get you killed for your trouble.」——Rian 的 maneuver 获赞、Nikolas 被斥 keep your right arm up。
facts.anchor: You cannot let yourself get distracted,

facts.fact: 椰枣酒记忆：事后兄弟偷酒减压（tipsy enough that their bruises hardly bothered them at all）。
facts.anchor: He’d reveal the bottle of palm wine

facts.fact: 兽战开局：talpascor 非领地内来袭——「Phos sent it.」——Edwin 撤令+亮出班卓十字弩；Julian 射甲、Rian 手枪打小眼。
团战：Fin 掷真炸弹断 talpascor 右腿——Nikolas 以 Lux 盾挡 stinger 光束坠沙、矛落数十步外。
facts.anchor: He yanked the safety pin out and threw the bomb

facts.fact: 觉醒一：Rian 下意识伸手——hexagram+circle+dot glyph 显现——矛 materialize 入手；「now the only warmth it held was from his own hands. Even the blade and the feathers looked duller.」
facts.anchor: Beyond his reaching hand hung a shining glyph

facts.fact: 觉醒二：掷矛+念张力线——矛消失（glyph 复现）→ Nikolas 手中闪光 materialize——「How did you—?」
facts.anchor: a hexagram and a circle and a dot.

facts.fact: 觉醒三：Nikolas 背对巨螯——父训两句回响——Rian 拽兄入 lightspeed——「He could use lightspeed not only on an object, but another person.」「He could spare his brother needless pain.」
facts.anchor: It will more likely than not get you killed for your trouble.

facts.fact: 兄弟连携：换位战术复刻童年（changed places with a resonating crack）——「The weapon in his hands was different, but it was a relief—it didn't conjure harmful memories, only potential.」
facts.anchor: Two against one, just like old times.
